headline: Claude Code VS Code extension backdoor confirmed by second outlet; Drupal Commerce flaw exploited; GitLab and Cisco KEV fixes due Nov 1

bullets.text: New: Help Net Security now also reports the Claude Code extension was poisoned with a persistent SSH backdoor, following The Hacker News report that the official VS Code extension was compromised.

New: Polymarket confirms the cyberattack hit a third-party provider after outages. Earlier reports: more than $2 million drained from traders via a crypto-draining script; trading halted, $2.5 million traced.
Drupal warns a critical Commerce Core flaw is exploited in attacks; The Hacker News identifies it as authorization bypass CVE-2026-118539.
Binance links its $6.3 billion crypto theft to a compromised DevOps laptop; SecurityWeek reports hallmarks of North Korea's TraderTraitor. Nearly $3 billion is frozen and withdrawals were paused.

CISA added exploited GitLab CE/EE RCE CVE-2026-97229 (CVSS 10.0) and Cisco ASA/FTD VPN DoS CVE-2026-76418 to KEV, both due 2026-11-01. An attacker already tried the GitLab flaw against Alpine Linux's instance.

Cisco SD-WAN flaw CVE-2026-20127 is exploited to deploy KeyDrift malware, tied to Volt Typhoon's 'Silent Train' network; China-linked attackers also used VMware ESX zero-day CVE-2026-41709, and Oracle EBS CVE-2026-101767 exploitation attempts have begun.

actions: If your developers use the Claude Code VS Code extension, check installed versions against the vendor's advisory and look for unexpected SSH keys or services.
If you run Drupal Commerce, apply the fix for CVE-2026-118539 now and review access logs for authorization bypass attempts.
Patch self-managed GitLab CE/EE for CVE-2026-97229 and Cisco ASA/FTD for CVE-2026-76418 before 2026-11-01; review logs for exploitation.
Apply your distro's kernel fix for Linux CVE-2026-46300 before its 2026-10-31 KEV due date (tomorrow).
Patch Cisco SD-WAN for CVE-2026-20127 and hunt for KeyDrift malware; patch VMware ESX CVE-2026-41709 and confirm Oracle EBS CVE-2026-101767 is fixed.
Polymarket and Binance users should rely only on official status channels and check wallets for unexpected approvals.
